verification_contract.requirement: Full current Workflow rule load and exact live MarketPulse/Workflow main bindings PASS.
Exact successor TaskContract and Authorized Amendment identities match their carriers; no newer UI-I01 successor/amendment/duplicate qualification supersedes this task.
Primary checkout path, remote repository identity, branch, HEAD, and git-dir/worktree relationship are explicitly proven without mutation.
Toolchain probe proves an eligible Git + PowerShell/.NET method is locally available; the qualified method has no Python, Node.js, third-party, install, or network dependency.
Selected method captures `git status --porcelain=v2 -z --untracked-files=all` through a binary-safe byte path and records exact raw bytes plus SHA-256.

Selected method deterministically enumerates the complete status path set, including recursively expanded untracked files and tracked modified/deleted paths; an independent Git-command cross-check shows set equality.
For every existing status path, snapshot records raw-file SHA-256 and bytes; every absent/deleted path is recorded as ABSENT; unsupported special-file handling fails closed.
Canonical snapshot serialization excludes nondeterministic fields, uses an explicit encoding and ordinal path ordering, and has its own byte count and SHA-256.
Two consecutive captures on the unchanged primary checkout produce exact equality of raw status bytes/hash, canonical snapshot bytes/hash, path set, states, per-file hashes, and byte counts.
Qualification itself causes zero repository/index/ref/worktree mutation; START and END repository observations are consistent, or any external concurrent change blocks qualification.
A reusable exact procedure/script is emitted under the external evidence root with byte count and SHA-256, and can be invoked from a path containing spaces without manual editing.

Structured result clearly states QUALIFIED or BLOCKED and does not claim persistence success, PRIMARY_WORKSPACE_PRESERVED for a future dispatch, Freeze, Implementation Authorization, Acceptance, or WRITE_MAIN.
